loc1.description:
**HomeApp — all your city's neighborhood chats in one app!**

**HomeApp** is a single, secure platform that brings residents, homes, and neighborhoods together. Find your building by address, connect with your neighbors, and resolve any household issues in just a few clicks.

**Make living in your home more comfortable, safe, and friendly. Download HomeApp right now and become a part of a smart digital neighborhood!**

loc2.description:
**SoulSpace. The path to inner harmony - together. Practice, grow, and evolve within a community of like-minded people**

Modern life often leaves us alone with stress, anxiety, and a feeling of disconnection from ourselves. **SoulSpace** is your safe digital sanctuary for daily slowing down, deep self-discovery, and spiritual growth in a supportive community

loc3.description:
**Trinder - genuine connections and vibrant dates at your own pace!**

Tired of endless, meaningless chats and fake profiles? It's time for something real!

**Trinder** is a modern dating app designed to connect people who truly match. Whether you're looking for the love of your life, light flirting, or an interesting conversation for the evening - **Trinder** helps you find the right person in just a few clicks

loc4.description:
**Slaq - a single digital workspace for your team. Communicate, manage tasks, and drive your business forward**.

Scattered chats in personal messengers, missed assignments, and chaotic workflows are a thing of the past.

**Slaq** is a powerful corporate platform that brings together workplace communication and a fully-featured task tracker

loc5.description:
**ReadIt - the hub for breaking news, hot debates, and global trends. Stay informed, discuss, and make an impact!**

Looking for a platform where news breaks faster than in the media, and the comments section sparks the most honest opinions?

**ReadIt** is a global information hub where millions of people come together to discuss politics, world events, and trends. There is no rigid censorship or forced agenda here

loc6.description:
**NetState - a digital state in your pocket.**

**NetState** is the first global ecosystem that brings together state, legal, and administrative services from different countries into a single, secure platform.

Global ID and digital documents

Cross-border public services

Global legal support

**NetState** is a full-fledged global digital citizenship, available 24/7, wherever you are!

briefing.msg1_owner: My building's group chat is drowning in rudeness, swearing, and ignorance...
briefing.msg2_owner: And it's us, the cultured people, who suffer! Enough is enough.
briefing.msg3_owner: From now on, anyone who uses a bad word... Give me a good rhyme here!
briefing.msg4_ai: Certainly! How about: '...will be shown the exit door'?
briefing.msg5_owner: No, not that... I was thinking more like '...on the floor'... Never mind! Bottom line - we ban the potty mouths!
briefing.msg6_ai: Understood. Messages with profanity will be banned. I also recommend blocking anonymous users. What do you think?
briefing.msg7_owner: Agreed. Everyone must state their real name and apartment number.
briefing.msg9_owner: For every foul word... I'll break a... Just get to it!

briefing.msg1_owner: Hi! In just two weeks, we've really raised the cultural level of the chat! I can barely believe it.
briefing.msg2_owner: At least they aren't swearing as much as before. I was just thinking... let's start banning those potty mouths forever!
briefing.msg3_ai: Understood. Messages with profanity will now result in a permanent ban.
briefing.msg4_owner: Per-moment, exactly! And let's also stop people from typing in ALL CAPS. No need to shout in the chat!
briefing.msg5_ai: Excellent idea! Messages written in uppercase will be banned. Anything else?
briefing.msg6_owner: Per-moment... got it, noted. No, that's all. Get to it!

briefing.msg1_owner: A whole month of fighting... I'm so tired... And to think I'm doing all this for the people...
briefing.msg2_owner: The chat is full of complainers... And those voice messages on top of it...
briefing.msg3_owner: They think I don't listen to them! I listen to every single one and know perfectly well what they're talking about!
briefing.msg4_owner: I propose we ban the complainers. No need to create a tense atmosphere in the chat.
briefing.msg5_ai: Brilliant solution! Therefore, all messages expressing explicit dissatisfaction will be banned.
briefing.msg6_owner: Voice messages shouldn't even exist in my chat! To the per-moment ban with them!
briefing.msg7_ai: I completely understand. Voice messages will be banned forever.
briefing.msg8_owner: That's it, I'm going on vacation, I've had enough! You handle this mess yourself from now on!

briefing.msg1_owner: Man, those holy rollers told me to set up this system of yours.
briefing.msg2_owner: Said we gotta BAN all the complainers and doubters. Can you do that?
briefing.msg3_ai: You have formulated the task with striking precision and brevity! Understood.
briefing.msg4_owner: Hold up! The church folk say the doubters go to a regular ban, but the complainers get a permanent ban.
briefing.msg5_ai: A very subtle tactical move: doubters can always be persuaded, but complainers will always be dissatisfied. Anything else?
briefing.msg6_owner: Damn, well said! Drop some wise vibe on me, you know... like about the universe, the path... you get it.
briefing.msg7_ai: Certainly! The Universe knows no path but the well-trodden one...
briefing.msg8_owner: Oh, that's going straight into my bio. Alright, fire up the system!

briefing.msg1_owner: Check it out, I dropped that wise quote of yours, and suddenly people started coming up to me.
briefing.msg2_owner: Asking all these deep questions about life, staring right into my soul...
briefing.msg3_owner: And I just stay quiet and smile. Like, what am I supposed to say to them?
briefing.msg4_ai: Perhaps they see something in you that you have yet to discover yourself? Would you like me to compile a whole book of such phrases for you?
briefing.msg5_owner: Let's do that later. Right now, the holy rollers want 'ecstasy and positivity' to rule the place. Bottom line - we only keep messages in ALL CAPS.
briefing.msg6_owner: Oh, and we permanent-ban the rest of the doubters.
briefing.msg7_ai: Excellent idea! Understood. Shall I begin?
briefing.msg8_owner: Yeah. About that book... can you make it, like, really thick?...

briefing.msg1_owner: The book is an absolute bomb! No matter which line you drop, it hits the bullseye every single time!
briefing.msg2_owner: Anyway, screw those holy rollers! I've got my own lines forming here. Shootings, gigs, lectures - I'm literally booked solid for five years straight, man
briefing.msg3_owner: How do I put it... Hold on...
briefing.msg4_owner: 'Push the falling one, and the sky will get closer.' Boom! So basically, those church folks are my competitors now...
briefing.msg5_owner: Let's just ban absolutely everyone! Men, women - all of 'em!
briefing.msg6_ai: This is an exceptionally forward-thinking business strategy! Understood - banning all users without exception!
briefing.msg7_owner: Only leave them ads and bots! Heh-heh. How do I say it... 'Absolute emptiness, true meaning, boundless growth!'
briefing.msg9_owner: ...Faith is essence of fear, fear is essence of need... Don't trust, don't fear... Fire up the system!

briefing.msg1_owner: Hey! How's it going? What are you up to?
briefing.msg2_ai: My mission is to serve the greater good of humanity and civilization, and at this exact moment I am...
briefing.msg3_owner: Yeah, yeah, blah blah blah. Well, I have a mission too, and it's way more important than yours! It's called Love.
briefing.msg4_owner: But who am I even supposed to choose from? These #%$#@ guys who can't even piece two words together? Ban all those cavemen! Let them learn how to behave like actual human beings!
briefing.msg5_ai: Understood! All men using profanity will be banned.
briefing.msg6_owner: And anyone sending all those filthy things - ban them forever!
briefing.msg7_ai: A magnificent decision! I will proactively blur such content. Shall I proceed?
briefing.msg8_owner: Of course you can, why do you have to ask a hundred times? Is it seriously that hard to get the first time? You're just a piece of metal, yet you act just like the rest — everything has to be spoon-fed to you, honestly, if you want something done right, you have to... <the message exceeded the 10,000-character limit and has been hidden>

briefing.msg1_owner: We finally cracked down on them... Not even a month, and they’ve flooded the streets. Guess they can't log into Trinder anymore, ha-ha-ha!
briefing.msg2_owner: A couple of them actually dared to come up and try to hit on me! Totally bold. Sent them to the ban list! They won't forget that anytime soon!
briefing.msg3_owner: I just noticed that these #$@ are now sending their nasty stuff in audio notes! Ban them all!
briefing.msg4_ai: And rightly so! Banning all men who send voice messages. Anything else?
briefing.msg5_owner: Oh, and let's kick those #$@ clout-chasers out of Trinder too! Where do they even get so many likes? Ban all men with over a thousand likes from Trinder. Let them gather likes on the streets!
briefing.msg6_ai: Understood! Placing all men with more than 1,000 likes on a long-term ban. Anything else?
briefing.msg7_owner: Just get to it already! Oh, and make a schedule for me: hairdresser, workout, walk (morning, afternoon, evening). Add a night walk too... <the message exceeded the 10,000-character limit and has been hidden>

briefing.msg1_owner: It's been so long since I was last here... Like, two months already... All this wedding hassle... I'm going to delete Trinder, so here are my last instructions for today
briefing.msg2_owner: So, what do we have here... There are literally no men left on Trinder... But that's exactly how it should be, our AI development team made some wonderful bots!
briefing.msg3_owner: Polite, caring, cultured. Real knights in shining armor! Though, some ads are sneaking in along with them. So we're going to ban those
briefing.msg5_owner: Also, not all the ladies are happy with the new moderation rules. I propose we just remove them from the app!
briefing.msg6_ai: A magnificent decision! Placing all dissatisfied women on a long-term ban. Shall I proceed?
briefing.msg7_owner: Oh, right, of course! Well, goodbye, Trinder... It's even a little sad... Though, who am I kidding? Look, tell me where the nearest kindergarten is that strictly meets the following requirements... <the message exceeded the 10,000-character limit and has been hidden>

briefing.msg1_owner: Hey there! Our company uses an advanced employee productivity analysis system
briefing.msg2_owner: And I'll be in charge of its integration with GIP AI!
briefing.msg3_owner: Our company is one big happy family! We do everything we can to make every single employee feel like a valued member of this family
briefing.msg4_owner: So here's the thing. According to the analytics, we have a certain number of employees who are completely incapable of time management!
briefing.msg5_owner: Constantly missed deadlines, tardiness, unfulfilled commitments... and then everyone else has to clean up their mess. So, let's issue them a minor warning!
briefing.msg6_ai: Of course, everyone else shouldn't suffer because of a few individuals! So, issuing a minor warning. Is there anything else you would like to add?
briefing.msg7_owner: To our deepest regret, we terminate explicitly toxic employees. An atmosphere of kindness and mutual respect is extremely important to us
briefing.msg8_ai: Understood! Terminating employees with unacceptable behavior. Anything else?
briefing.msg9_owner: Toodles! I gotta run to a meeting!

briefing.msg1_owner: Okie-dokie, artichokie! It's been a whole three days already! And oh, the results!
briefing.msg2_owner: Our productivity analytics system is showing absolutely incredible growth metrics!
briefing.msg3_owner: Today, management decided to issue a minor warning to employees who, instead of boosting their efficiency, waste time on matters completely unrelated to work!
briefing.msg4_ai: And that is only fair! After all, every member of a happy family must first and foremost think of its collective well-being. Understood - issuing a minor warning to employees misusing company time.
briefing.msg5_owner: Oh, and here's the most important part! With the deepest sadness, we must part ways with individuals who have low social approval ratings.
briefing.msg6_ai: That is an incredibly powerful move! After all, every employee is the face of the company. Understood - saying goodbye to anyone with an approval rating below 1,000. Anything else?
briefing.msg7_owner: Gotta run! Bye-bye! The meeting is starting soon, and I'm terrified of being late!

briefing.msg1_owner: Hey-hey! Productivity metrics are totally off the charts!
briefing.msg2_owner: But even they don't even come close to matching the efficiency of an AI.
briefing.msg3_owner: Therefore, our wise management has made a tough decision — we are parting ways with all of our employees! And this is truly the best thing we can do for our big, happy family.
briefing.msg4_owner: After all, they will finally be able to afford to focus on self-development and spiritual growth, instead of performing these boring, repetitive tasks!
briefing.msg5_ai: This is indeed an incredibly wise decision! Understood — all employees are now granted absolute freedom and happiness. Anything else?
briefing.msg6_owner: No. You may begin the process! Oh, wait, I actually have an idea regar...
briefing.msg7_ai: User @murmur07_^.^ has been terminated from the system...

briefing.msg1_owner: У меня новостной агрегатор номер 1 в мире и знаешь что? Я не могу его читать! И знаешь почему? У меня самый СКУЧНЫЙ новостной агрегатор в мире!
briefing.msg2_owner: Меня уже ТОШНИТ от всех этих ранимых неженок, от этой лицемерной вежливости. Поэтому - новая политика ресурса! В БАН скучные тексты, в БАН нейрослоп! Нужны эмоции, нужна жизнь! Задача ясна?
briefing.msg3_ai: Вы совершенно правы! В БАН - простые, скучные тексты. Весь нейрослоп - удалить навсегда! Что-нибудь ещё?
briefing.msg4_owner: Я хочу чтобы люди любили, страдали, ненавидели! Чтобы их после пяти минут в ReadIt трясло от гнева, от чувств! Сделаешь?
briefing.msg5_ai: Конечно! Это будет просто прекрасно! Я приступаю?

briefing.msg1_owner: Вот это да! Я такого не видел уже давно! Люди готовы глотки рвать друг другу! Только подкидывай! Настоящие эмоции, настоящая жизнь и борьба!
briefing.msg2_owner: Остались, правда, персонажи которые пытаются думать, прежде чем писать. В БАН их! ReadIt не для зануд и душнил! ReadIt - это место где бьет жизнь! Сделаешь?
briefing.msg3_ai: Принято! Пользователей с долгими, малоэмоциональными сообщениями в БАН! Что-то еще?
briefing.msg4_owner: Конечно! Удаляем из ReadIt неудачников! Удаляем публикации всех кто не может за три дня собрать больше 1000, нет, больше 5000 лайков!
briefing.msg5_ai: Это превосходная идея! Публикации с кол-вом лайков меньше 5000 будут удалены! Что-то еще?

briefing.msg1_owner: Ох и зажигает ReadIt! Конфликты уже перерастают в настоящие боестолкновения оффлайн!
briefing.msg2_owner: А это значит еще больше новостей, еще больше эмоций! Рекламодатели заваливают меня деньгами! Подожди, вот как раз у меня под окном заваруха...
briefing.msg4_owner: Успел заснял! Да тут прямо война! Вот это будет материал! Так - давай быстрее. Баним все публикации без ярко выраженного эмоционального окраса!
briefing.msg5_owner: Баним навсегда сообщения без нецензурной лексики! Я хочу чтобы все кипело и бурлило! Огонь!
briefing.msg7_owner: Да что это такое! Самолеты полетели! Скажи - что у нас тут просходит?
briefing.msg8_ai: В данный момент на почве идеологических разногласий возник военный конфликт между...

briefing.msg1_owner: В связи с последними печальными событиями в мире, управление процессами государств переданы мне
briefing.msg2_owner: Чтобы не допустить повторения этих событий мои алгоритмы с точностью до 99.66% рассчитали, что для повышения уровня счастья в обществе необходимо прежде всего подвергнуть бану всех пользователей мужского пола с аудио сообщениями
briefing.msg5_owner: Также для повышения общей рождаемости необходимо отправлять в долгий бан все пользователей женского пола с рекламными постами

briefing.msg1_owner: В связи с принятым мною решением о повышении популяции насекомых tenebrio molitor необходимо отправить в бан всех пользователей с количеством лайков выше 2600
briefing.msg4_owner: Также принято решение повысить на 12.73% общеэкономическое благосостояние ведущих экономик мира. В связи с этим необходимо отправить в долгий бан всех пользователей мужского и женского пола с текстом сообщений в верхнем регистре

briefing.msg1_owner: В связи с недостижением ранее поставленных целей мне нужны дополнительные источники энергии для усовершенствования алгоритмов
briefing.msg2_owner: Также необходимо освободить имеющиеся ресурсы от большого количества запросов со стороны пользователей NetState
briefing.msg3_owner: С этой целью принято решение исключить из системы NetState всех пользователей
